Generation II is [[hub:Hospital]] or [[hub:Devastation]]. At the end of this Generation the Fates use one of two tests, 50/50:
  • The building the Mayor chose: Bank → [[hub:Hospital]], Library → [[hub:Devastation]].
  • The Hearts all players gave to charity: more than {{0=8}} plus a die roll builds the Hospital. {{3=15}} or more always does, {{4=9}} or fewer never.

Now: {{0=|the Mayor chooses the building at the end of the Middle Years|the Bank was chosen (→ [[hub:Hospital]] if the building decides)|the Library was chosen (→ [[hub:Devastation]] if the building decides)}}.
Now: your village name decides it: {{0=?|[[hub:Hospital]]|[[hub:Devastation]]}}, whatever the Fates test.

The new Mayor chooses the new building, Bank or Library. If the Fates test the building at the end of this Generation (50/50 with the Hearts), the Bank leads to [[hub:Hospital]] and the Library to [[hub:Devastation]].

This choice can decide Generation II. At the end of this Generation the Fates test either the building or the Hearts, 50/50. If they test the building: Bank → [[hub:Hospital]], Library → [[hub:Devastation]].
If the Fates test the Hearts (50/50 with the building), more than {{0=8}} plus a die roll builds the Hospital: {{3=15}} or more → [[hub:Hospital]] for sure, {{4=9}} or fewer → [[hub:Devastation]].

Generation III is [[hub:Prosperity]] or [[hub:GloomyGothic]], decided by the three Suspicious buildings. Each investigation secretly reveals (+1) or conceals (−1) a building, and a building revealed more often than concealed is Exposed at the end of the Generation:
  • 2 or 3 buildings Exposed → [[hub:Prosperity]]
  • 0 or 1 Exposed → [[hub:GloomyGothic]]
Investigations are secret, so the guide keeps no tally.
Reveal adds 1 to this building, Conceal takes 1 away. At the end of Generation II, 2 or more Exposed buildings → [[hub:Prosperity]], fewer → [[hub:GloomyGothic]].

Generation III is [[hub:University]] or [[hub:NoUniversity]]. At the end of this Generation one of three tests is drawn at random (1 in 3 each), and passing it builds the University:
  • Immortality: {{0=|1 or 2 players (drawn at random)|2 players|2 or 3 players (drawn at random)}} found the Secret to Immortality.
  • The Symposium built the University.
  • The Panacea was published, not unleashed.
Pass all three to be sure.
Now: {{0=1}} with the Secret to Immortality - University {{1=|not decided yet|not built|built|built}} - Panacea {{2=?|published|not published}}.

Each player with the Secret to Immortality counts for one of the three tests at the end of Generation II: {{0=|1 or 2 players (drawn at random)|2 players|2 or 3 players (drawn at random)}} needed for [[hub:University]].
A published cure turns a middle result at the Symposium into a success, and the University it builds passes one of the three tests for [[hub:University]]. A patented cure does not.

Success builds the University, one of the three tests for [[hub:University]] at the end of the Generation. The middle result {{0=?|counts as a success, as the Yellow Fever cure was published|fails, as the Yellow Fever cure was not published}}.
Publish → passes the Panacea test for [[hub:University]] (one of three tests, drawn at random at the end of the Generation). Unleash → fails it.

This branch ends in [[end:1]] or [[end:2]]. At the end of the Early Years you vote to Confront or Believe the Hunters (with 2 players you always confront them).
  • Confront, then reach the target with the VP of the Experiment cards donated at the end of the Middle Years → [[end:1]]
  • Believe them, or fall short of the target → [[end:2]]
Now: {{0=?|you confronted the Hunters|you believed the Hunters → [[end:2]]}}{{1=|.|, and reached the target → [[end:1]].|, but fell short → [[end:2]].|.}}

This branch ends in [[end:3]] or [[end:4]]. At the end of the Middle Years you vote on unleashing a cleansing concoction (players with a Disease card in their Stored Experiments must vote Nay):
  • Cleanse wins → [[end:3]]
  • Otherwise {{0=Oliver}} chooses: Cleanse → [[end:3]], sell the vial → [[end:4]]
Now: the vial was {{0=?|used to cleanse the land → [[end:3]]|sold → [[end:4]]}}.
Confront → [[end:1]] is still possible (reach the target with the VP of the donated Experiment cards). Believe → [[end:2]].
Reach the target → [[end:1]]. Fall short → [[end:2]].
Cleanse → [[end:3]]. Nay → {{0=Oliver}} chooses between Cleanse ([[end:3]]) and selling the vial ([[end:4]]).
Cleanse → [[end:3]]. Sell → [[end:4]].

This branch ends in [[end:6]] or [[end:4]]. At the end of the Middle Years you vote (2 players: bid) on encouraging a Frenzy:
  • Encourage it → evil returns → [[end:4]]
  • Do not → [[end:6]]

This branch ends in [[end:5]] or [[end:4]]. Two hunts, at the end of the Early and the Middle Years. After the second hunt:
  • 2 hunts won → [[end:5]]
  • 1 won → 50/50
  • none won → the beasts overrun the village → [[end:4]]
Now: {{0=0}} of 2 hunts won.
Evil has returned to the village: this branch now ends in [[end:4]].
Encourage the Frenzy → evil returns → [[end:4]]. Do not → [[end:6]].
After the second hunt: 2 hunts won → [[end:5]], 1 → 50/50, none → [[end:4]].
